scope: Production SMTP submission phase timing, reply-stage validation, delivery-certainty mapping, cancellation cleanup, and vendored Lettre provenance. This is focused Rust source evidence. Full-source, deep-server, native, provider, packaged-app, and release results remain separate.

phasePolicy.semantics: There is no absolute transaction deadline. Greeting, setup, MAIL, every RCPT, DATA initiation, each successful DATA stream write and flush, terminator write, and final reply receive their own bounded budget. DATA progress resets its timer after each successful write.

replyAndOutcomePolicy: Greeting requires 220; EHLO requires 250; STARTTLS requires 220; AUTH succeeds only with 235; DATA initiation requires 354.
MAIL and RCPT accept positive-completion class replies. Wrong-stage 3xx replies stop before the next command.
A content write failure before the terminator is NotSubmitted and drops the connection without QUIT, retry, or reuse.
An explicit final 451 or 554 is NotSubmitted because the relay confirmed rejection.
Terminator failure or final timeout, EOF, malformed reply, or 3xx reply is DeliveryUncertain.
Sent append occurs only after a final positive-completion reply. An uncertain result never triggers automatic SMTP retry or Sent append.
The send future exclusively owns its connection. Cancellation drops the connection and never returns it to a pool.

findingsClosed: Final 354 can no longer become false delivery success.
Malformed or excessive AUTH challenges poison the connection; AUTH succeeds only on exact 235.
Public MailService::send reaches the single no-timeout-argument production helper.
Final 451 and 554 map to NotSubmitted; missing or invalid final acknowledgement remains DeliveryUncertain.
Cancellation and all DATA errors drop the exclusively owned connection without unbounded QUIT cleanup, retry, or reuse.
independentReview.externalGate: Vendored-crate root verification remained blocked at review time only because the separately changing mail-parser vendor manifest was not yet frozen. The Lettre manifest and isolated verifier passed.

limits: The one TLS 1.1 OpenSSL capability test is explicitly ignored and provides no passing evidence.
SMTP timeout values are internal policy and are not runtime or user configurable.
The separate read-only smtp_auth_probe retains its single 20-second probe deadline and never reaches MAIL, RCPT, DATA, or message submission.
Only Tokio with rustls is covered by the Dakia vendor patch. Async-std, native-tls, and boring-tls behavior remains upstream.
A real DNS resolver stall and a real unroutable multi-address TCP target are not independently deterministic in CI. The timeout helper and synchronized public constructor path are covered.
This record does not claim a full-source, independent-server, native WebKit, live-provider, packaged-app, upgrade, signing, notarization, publication, or release pass.
